title: Laws of Motion
subject: Physics
chapter: Ch 9: Force and Laws of Motion

questions.q: What is the SI unit of force?
questions.explanation: Force is measured in Newtons (N), where 1 N = 1 kg·m/s².

questions.q: Which property of an object determines its inertia?
questions.explanation: Inertia is directly proportional to the mass of an object.

questions.q: Which law states that for every action, there is an equal and opposite reaction?
questions.explanation: Newton's Third Law describes action-reaction force pairs.

questions.q: What is the formula derived from Newton's Second Law of Motion?
questions.explanation: Force equals mass multiplied by acceleration (F = ma).

questions.q: A momentum of an object of mass m moving with velocity v is given by:
questions.explanation: Momentum (p) is defined as the product of mass and velocity (p = mv).
